requirements.question: Where are national or regional internet connectivity, BGP routing, or public communications networks degraded or shut down worldwide?
Which countries or autonomous systems (ASNs) are experiencing a >=25% drop in BGP reachable prefixes or active probing responsiveness?
Where are simultaneous multi-country BGP drops consistent with a submarine cable cut or landing-station fault rather than a domestic policy shutdown?
Where is application-layer censorship (OONI confirmed blocks or TLS/DNS anomalies >=15%) surging ahead of or alongside connectivity curfews?
What is the percentage drop from the 7-day baseline across BGP visibility and active probing (Ping-Slash24) for the affected country or ASN?
Which submarine cable systems and landing stations serve the simultaneously degraded countries?
